tdtr-1-two-tint: Complementary edge filters select different spectral bands from one femtosecond laser for pump and probe, suppressing scattered pump light. The modulated pump heats the transducer; delayed probe reflectance tracks cooling. A multilayer thermal model fits the lock-in signal ratio to extract conductivity or interface conductance when sensitivity permits.
利用互补边缘滤光片，从同一飞秒激光光谱中选取不同波段作为泵浦光和探测光，抑制泵浦散射串扰。调制泵浦加热金属传感层，延迟探测光读取冷却过程中的反射率变化；在灵敏度允许时，用多层导热模型拟合锁相信号比，提取热导率或界面热导。
tdtr-2-two-color: Pump and probe use distinct wavelengths, separated by wavelength-selective optics. Pump pulses heat the transducer; the probe samples reflectance at controlled delays. Model fitting extracts thermal properties within the sample's sensitivity window. Wavelength separation reduces pump leakage but does not eliminate fluorescence or all optical backgrounds.
泵浦与探测光采用不同波长，并通过选波光学元件分离。泵浦脉冲加热金属传感层，探测光在受控延迟下读取反射率变化；结合热模型，在样品灵敏度窗口内反演热物性。波长分离可降低泵浦串扰，但不能保证消除荧光等全部光学背景。
tdtr-3: A modulated pump-pulse train heats the sample transducer. Scanning the probe delay measures the transient thermoreflectance response, which is fitted with a multilayer heat-flow model. This line is under construction; its validated performance will be established during commissioning.
调制泵浦脉冲序列加热样品表面的金属传感层，扫描探测光延迟以测量瞬态热反射响应，并用多层传热模型拟合。该系统仍在建设中，实际测量性能需经调试与标定确认。
sstr-1-lab: A continuous-wave pump, or modulation slow enough for quasi-steady heating, raises the transducer temperature. The probe measures thermoreflectance versus absorbed pump power. Calibration and a steady heat-flow model yield thermal conductivity; interface sensitivity depends on the layer structure and beam size.
连续泵浦光或足够慢的调制加热，使金属传感层达到近稳态温升。探测光测量热反射响应随吸收泵浦功率的变化；通过标定与稳态传热模型提取热导率。界面参数的可辨识性取决于膜层结构与光斑尺寸。
sstr-2-semi-integrated: The semi-integrated version uses the same steady-heating principle as laboratory SSTR. Pump-induced heat spreads through the film stack and substrate; the probe measures the resulting surface-reflectance change. Fitting the power-normalized response requires known beam geometry and calibration. Integration changes implementation, not the underlying measurement physics.
半集成版本沿用稳态泵浦加热原理，热量经膜层与衬底扩散，探测光读取由表面温升引起的反射率变化。拟合功率归一化响应时，需要光斑几何与响应标定。集成程度改变实现形式，不改变基本测量原理。
sstr-3-integrated: An integrated optical head measures the steady thermoreflectance response to absorbed pump power. A reference measurement calibrates the response, and a heat-flow model accounts for beam size and sample layers. Thermal parameters are reported only where the response is sufficiently sensitive; integration alone does not guarantee accuracy or repeatability.
集成光学头测量吸收泵浦功率引起的稳态热反射响应，通过参考测量标定，并用包含光斑尺寸与样品膜层的传热模型分析。仅在响应灵敏度足够时提取相应热参数；集成化本身不能代替准确度和重复性验证。
fdtr: A sinusoidally modulated pump heats the transducer while a probe detects reflectance modulation. A lock-in amplifier measures phase and amplitude across modulation frequencies. A multilayer thermal model fits this frequency response; conductivity, heat capacity and interface conductance are distinguishable only when the data provide sufficient sensitivity.
正弦调制泵浦光加热金属传感层，探测光读取反射率调制；锁相放大器测量不同调制频率下的相位与幅值。通过多层热模型拟合频率响应，在数据灵敏度足够时区分热导率、热容与界面热导的贡献。
fastr: FASTR combines FDTR frequency-response measurements with SSTR steady-heating measurements on one platform. The two modes probe complementary heat-flow regimes. Their data can constrain a common thermal model, but which parameters can be extracted depends on sample structure, calibration and sensitivity.
FASTR 在同一平台结合 FDTR 频率响应测量与 SSTR 稳态加热测量，两种模式探测互补的传热过程。两类数据可共同约束热模型，但可提取的参数仍取决于样品结构、标定与灵敏度。
micro-raman: Inelastic light scattering probes lattice vibrations. Calibrated peak shifts, linewidths or anti-Stokes/Stokes ratios can indicate temperature; strain also shifts or splits peaks. Temperature and stress therefore require suitable mode-specific calibration or independent constraints. Probe-laser heating must be assessed before spatial mapping.
非弹性光散射探测晶格振动。经标定的峰位、线宽或反斯托克斯／斯托克斯强度比可用于测温，应变也会引起峰移或劈裂。温度与应力需通过适当的模态标定或独立约束区分，空间扫描前还需评估探测激光自身的加热。
qfi-infrared-microscopy: Infrared optics image the device's thermal radiation onto a detector. Radiance calibration converts the signal into temperature, with corrections for emissivity, reflected background and optical transmission. Semitransparent layers can contribute radiation from multiple depths, so the signal is not automatically the junction temperature.
红外光学系统将器件热辐射成像到探测器，通过辐射标定并校正发射率、背景反射与光路透过率，换算温度。半透明膜层可能使不同深度的辐射叠加，因此测得的辐射温度不能自动等同于结温。
microsanj: An illuminated microscope and camera measure surface-reflectance changes; a calibrated thermoreflectance coefficient converts these into temperature changes. For repeatable electrical pulses, delayed illumination samples different times over many cycles. Temporal resolution depends on optical gating, exposure and synchronization jitter, rather than camera frame rate alone.
照明显微镜与相机测量表面反射率变化，利用标定的热反射系数换算温度变化。对于可重复的电脉冲，通过改变照明延迟，在多次循环中采样不同时刻。时间分辨率由光学门控、曝光与同步抖动共同决定，不能仅由相机帧率判断。
device-thermoreflectance: The planned system compares device reflectance before and during electrical heating. Calibrating the material- and wavelength-dependent thermoreflectance coefficient gives temperature changes. Synchronized illumination and readout can sample repeatable transients; the installed timing performance and uncertainty must be verified during commissioning.
拟建系统比较器件电加热前后的反射率，利用材料与波长相关的热反射系数标定，得到温度变化。同步照明与读出可采样可重复的瞬态过程；实际时序性能与测量不确定度需在调试阶段验证。
fd-pbd: A modulated pump heats the coated sample and adjacent dielectric liquid. The liquid's temperature-dependent refractive-index gradient deflects an offset probe beam; thermoelastic surface motion can also contribute. Position-sensitive detection and lock-in analysis measure amplitude and phase, which a coupled model fits to thermal conductivity or interface conductance.
调制泵浦加热镀膜样品与邻近介电液体。液体中随温度变化的折射率梯度使偏置探测光偏转，样品表面热弹性运动也可能贡献信号。位置敏感探测器与锁相分析获取幅值和相位，再用耦合模型反演热导率或界面热导。
instec-cryogenic-chamber: Cooling removes heat from the sample stage, while a heater and temperature sensor form a feedback loop to regulate its setpoint. Optical access allows coupled spectroscopy or thermoreflectance. The sensor measures its local stage temperature; sample temperature and uniformity also depend on contact, heat load and equilibration.
制冷系统带走样品台热量，加热器与温度传感器构成反馈回路，稳定设定温度。光学通道支持联用光谱或热反射测量。传感器读数对应其局部样品台温度，样品实际温度与均匀性还取决于接触、热负载和平衡时间。
tdtr-beam-offset: Scanning the lateral pump–probe separation measures a spatial thermoreflectance profile. Its width and shape depend on lateral heat diffusion, beam sizes and modulation conditions. An anisotropic heat-flow model, using scans along selected directions, constrains in-plane conductivity; anisotropy does not inherently shift the profile peak.
扫描泵浦与探测光斑的横向间距，获得空间热反射响应；其宽度和形状取决于面内热扩散、光斑尺寸与调制条件。沿选定方向扫描，并结合各向异性传热模型，可约束面内热导率。各向异性本身并不必然使响应峰位移动。
olympus-optical-microscope: An objective collects light reflected by the sample; the imaging optics form a magnified image at the eyepiece or camera. Illumination and sample optical properties produce contrast. Resolution is limited by wavelength and numerical aperture; quantitative dimensions require a calibrated image scale.
物镜收集样品反射光，由成像光学系统在目镜或相机上形成放大图像。照明方式与样品光学性质产生对比度，分辨率受波长与数值孔径限制；定量尺寸测量需要标定图像比例。
high-resolution-stages: The stage moves the sample relative to a fixed measurement spot. Position feedback in closed-loop operation reduces positioning error, and synchronized acquisition associates each signal with a coordinate. Commanded step size is distinct from positioning accuracy and from the optical or thermal spatial resolution.
位移台使样品相对固定测量光斑移动，闭环位置反馈降低定位误差，同步采集将信号与坐标关联。指令步长不等于实际定位准确度，也不等于光学或热学测量的空间分辨率。
probe-station: Positioned probes contact device pads. Connected source and measurement instruments apply electrical bias and record current–voltage response; optical access allows simultaneous thermometry. The probe station supplies contacts and sample positioning, while thermal measurements come from the coupled optical instrument.
定位探针接触器件焊盘，由连接的电源与测量仪器施加电偏压并读取电流–电压响应；光学通道支持同步测温。探针台提供电接触与样品定位，热学信号由联用光学设备测得。
four-point-probe: Outer probes source current and inner probes sense voltage with negligible current draw, reducing lead and contact-resistance errors. A geometry factor converts V/I into sheet resistance; resistivity additionally requires film thickness. Finite size, unequal spacing, multilayers and self-heating require appropriate corrections.
外侧探针通入电流，内侧探针以近似不取电流的方式测量电压，降低引线和接触电阻误差。结合几何因子，由 V/I 得到方阻，再结合膜厚得到电阻率。有限尺寸、非等距探针、多层导电与自热影响需适当修正。
ultrasonic-cleaning: A transducer drives pressure oscillations in the cleaning liquid. Cavitation bubbles grow and collapse, producing local shear, shock waves and near-surface microjets that dislodge contaminants. Cleaning also depends on solvent chemistry; excessive cavitation can damage fragile films or structures.
换能器在清洗液中产生超声压力振荡，空化气泡生长并塌缩，形成局部剪切、冲击波与近表面微射流，剥离污染物。清洗效果还取决于清洗液化学性质，过强空化可能损伤脆弱薄膜或结构。
microchannel-cooling-setup: Heat conducts from the chip into channel walls and transfers to flowing coolant by convection. For steady single-phase flow, mass flow and inlet/outlet temperatures give removed heat after heat-loss corrections. Chip temperature gives thermal resistance; extracting a heat-transfer coefficient also requires wall-to-fluid temperature and area. Pressure drop determines hydraulic pumping power.
热量由芯片传导至通道壁，再通过对流传给冷却液。稳态单相流下，结合质量流量与进出口温差，并修正散热损失，可求移除热量。芯片温升用于计算热阻；换热系数还需要壁面–流体温差与换热面积。压降决定液压泵功。
shared-cvd-diamond: 富氢 CVD 金刚石生长

Activation of a hydrogen-rich carbon-precursor gas produces reactive growth species. Carbon incorporates at a heated, prepared substrate, while atomic hydrogen helps stabilize diamond surfaces and preferentially removes non-diamond carbon. Activation method, substrate preparation and process conditions determine growth quality.
富氢含碳前驱气体经活化产生生长所需的活性物种，碳在经处理、加热的衬底表面沉积。原子氢有助于稳定金刚石表面，并优先去除非金刚石碳。活化方式、衬底处理与工艺条件共同决定生长质量。
shared-surface-activated-bonding: Energetic neutral or ion irradiation cleans and activates mating surfaces in vacuum. Bringing sufficiently smooth, aligned surfaces into contact enables low-temperature bonding. Bond quality depends on contamination, roughness and beam damage; the interfacial layer and any annealing treatment are material-dependent.
在真空中用高能中性束或离子束清洁并活化待键合表面，将足够平整、对准的表面接触，实现低温键合。键合质量受污染、粗糙度与束流损伤影响，界面层及后续退火需按材料组合确定。
shared-high-vacuum-pvd: PVD transfers source material to a substrate in a vacuum chamber. Evaporation generates vapour by heating; sputtering ejects target atoms by ion bombardment. The arriving species condense into a film. The applicable source type and controls depend on the installed tool; PVD is not synonymous with magnetron sputtering.
PVD 在真空腔体内将源材料输运至衬底：蒸发通过加热产生蒸气，溅射通过离子轰击靶材释放原子，到达衬底的物种凝聚成膜。适用的源类型与控制参数取决于实际设备，PVD 不能直接等同于磁控溅射。
shared-tem-phonon-eels: Electron transmission and scattering provide structural images of thin specimens. A monochromated beam and energy-loss spectrometer resolve small losses associated with vibrational excitations. Background subtraction and spatial scanning identify phonon signals near interfaces; these spectra do not directly measure thermal conductivity or boundary conductance.
电子束透射与散射用于获取薄样品结构像，单色化电子束与能量损失谱仪分辨振动激发对应的微小能量损失。结合背景处理和空间扫描，可识别界面附近的声子信号；这些能谱不直接等同于热导率或界面热导测量。
